relevant_sections: Regulation of LpxC in E. coli
Effects of misregulated lipid A biosynthesis
Regulation of alternative points in lipid A biosynthesis
requested_context.selected_example: lipid A biosynthesis in Escherichia coli

candidate_examples.name: Escherichia coli lipid A biosynthesis
candidate_examples.evidence: The regulation of LpxC in the model organism Escherichia coli has been the subject of immense study

candidate_examples.name: Pseudomonas aeruginosa LpxC regulation by MurA
candidate_examples.evidence: Pa LpxC is regulated by a wholly unique mechanism: it is activated by direct binding to the committed enzyme in the competing PG biosynthetic pathway, MurA

candidate_examples.name: Neisseria meningitidis LpxC regulation by Ght
candidate_examples.evidence: the N. meningitidis LapB homolog Ght was suggested to regulate LpxC through an FtsH-independent mechanism by localizing LpxC to the IM to promote LPS biosynthesis

candidate_examples.name: Agrobacterium tumefaciens LpxC degradation by Lon
candidate_examples.evidence: LpxC was degraded... due to the Lon protease

candidate_examples.name: Rhodobacter capsulatus LpxC degradation by Lon
candidate_examples.evidence: both A. tumefaciences and R. capsulatus LpxC was degraded... due to the Lon protease

candidate_examples.name: Rhodobacter sphaeroides LpxC regulation by NtrYX
candidate_examples.evidence: In R. sphaeroides, an ntrYX mutant exhibited approximately nine-fold elevated lpxC transcript abundance

candidate_examples.name: Caulobacter crescentus LpxC regulation by NtrYX and ChvGI
candidate_examples.evidence: In C. crescentus, an additional layer of control is imposed by the ChvGI two component system, which activates lpxC transcription

candidate_examples.name: Cronobacter sakazakii LpxA regulation by LabP
candidate_examples.evidence: In the gammaproteobacterium Cronobacter sakazakii, LpxA was found to interact with LabP... addition of purified LabP was sufficient to stimulate LpxA activity in vitro

candidate_examples.name: Francisella tularensis LpxA regulation by RipA
candidate_examples.evidence: RipA was suggested to inhibit LpxA activity due to the ability of hypomorphic LpxA variants to suppress ripA mutant phenotypes

candidate_examples.name: Acinetobacter baumannii lack of LpxC regulation
candidate_examples.evidence: the critical priority pathogen A. baumannii does not appear to control LpxC activity through any of the known regulatory mechanisms
